long_biography.plain_text:
At Baker Motor Company, Tommy Baker has built a business culture around training as well as luxury-car retail. The Charleston owner said every employee received extensive annual instruction, an approach that helped the group earn national workplace recognition. He also spent 22 years teaching entrepreneurship at the College of Charleston, preferring the role of mentor to lecturer.

Baker brought that educational emphasis back to The Citadel, where his gift—then the business programme's largest cash donation—led the school to take his and his wife Victoria's names. In 2018, he founded Beacon Community Bank and remains its chairman, adding locally controlled banking to his long automotive career.
